questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Assesses enterprise-level disaster recovery design for SAP on AWS, requiring understanding of SAP HANA replication, cross-region networking, IAM security, and automation orchestration under strict RPO/RTO requirements.

## Key Concepts

- SAP HANA system replication modes (sync/async) and log shipping mechanisms
- Cross-region infrastructure failover and network connectivity patterns
- Least privilege IAM with just-in-time access for emergency scenarios
- Automation orchestration using Step Functions for complex multi-step processes
- DR validation testing and RPO/RTO measurement methodologies

## Code Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SAP DR Cross-Account Role and Step Functions Infrastructure'

Parameters:
  PrimaryAccount:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Primary AWS Account ID'
  DRAccount:
    Type: String
    Description: 'DR AWS Account ID'

Resources:
  DROperatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sap-dr-operator
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${PrimaryAccount}:root'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'sts:ExternalId': 'sap-dr-jit-{{timestamp}}'
              Bool:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': true
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPDROperations
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:RebootInstances
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:RequestedRegion': ['us-east-1', 'us-west-2']
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets
                  - route53:ListResourceRecordSets
                Resource: 'arn:aws:route53:::hostedzone/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartSession
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'ssm:ResourceTag/Environment': 'SAP-DR'
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600

  SAPFailoverStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: SAP-DR-Failover
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        !Sub |
        {
          "StartAt": "ValidateDRRegion",
          "States": {
            "ValidateDRRegion": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "FunctionName": "${ValidationFunction}"
              },
              "Next": "CheckPrimaryStatus"
            },
            "CheckPrimaryStatus": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.PrimaryStatus",
                  "StringEquals": "FAILED",
                  "Next": "PromoteDRInstance"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "Failback"
            },
            "PromoteDRInstance": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "FunctionName": "${PromoteFunction}",
                "Payload": {
                  "Region": "us-west-2"
                }
              },
              "Next": "UpdateDNS"
            },
            "UpdateDNS": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "FunctionName": "${DNSFunction}"
              },
              "Next": "VerifyFailover"
            },
            "VerifyFailover": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "FunctionName": "${VerifyFunction}"
              },
              "Next": "CleanupResources"
            },
            "CleanupResources": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
              "Parameters": {
                "FunctionName": "${CleanupFunction}"
              },
              "End": true
            },
            "Failback": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            }
          }
        }

  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsLambdaAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: '*'

Outputs:
  DROperatorRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the SAP DR Operator Role'
    Value: !GetAtt DROperatorRole.Arn
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the SAP Failover State Machine'
    Value: !Ref SAPFailoverStateMachine
```

## Implementation Details

**SAP HANA Replication Configuration:** Configure system replication with sync mode for critical tables, async mode for others. Set log shipping interval to 1 second for 5-second RPO. Use storage-level snapshots every 15 minutes for point-in-time recovery.

**Network Architecture:** Deploy Transit Gateway with auto VPN failover between regions, configure cross-region VPC peering for SAP application connectivity, and implement Route 53 health checks with weighted routing for automated cutover.

**Testing Framework:** Conduct monthly health checks, quarterly full DR drills with production data clones, and continuous monitoring of replication lag with automated alerts on threshold breaches.

questions.explanation:
## How It Works

Zero-downtime patching for SAP HANA scale-out leverages SAP HANA System Replication (HSR) at the node level. Worker nodes are patched in a rolling fashion: secondary nodes patched while the primary serves traffic. After validation, a graceful takeover promotes patched secondary becomes new primary, then former primary is patched. Step Functions orchestrates the sequence: health pre-check, patch secondary, validate, takeover, patch former primary, final validation. SSM Automation executes OS/SAP patches on EC2 instances.

## Key Points

- **HSR takeover**: Graceful failover at node-level system replication enables seamless cutover
- **Rolling sequence**: Patch secondary nodes first, validate, then takeover to make them primary
- **Health gates**: SAPControl checks + SAP HANA Cockpit validation between each step
- **Least privilege**: IAM roles restricting SSM/EC2 actions only to patch-orchestration needs
- **Canary rollback**: Step Functions choice states with health-based rollback triggers

## Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  PatchOrchestrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ['states.amazonaws.com', 'ssm.amazonaws.com']
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPPatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:SendCommand'
                  - 'ssm:GetCommandInvocation'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
                Resource: '*'
```

```json
{
  "Comment": "SAP Zero-Downtime Patch Orchestration",
  "StartAt": "PrePatchHealthCheck",
  "States": {
    "PrePatchHealthCheck": {
      "Type": "Task",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
      "Parameters": {
        "FunctionName": "sap-health-check"
      },
      "Next": "PatchSecondaryNodes"
    },
    "PatchSecondaryNodes": {
      "Type": "Task",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:ssm:sendCommand",
      "Next": "ValidateSecondaryHealth"
    },
    "ValidateSecondaryHealth": {
      "Type": "Choice",
      "Choices": [
        {
          "Variable": "$.healthOk",
          "BooleanEquals": true,
          "Next": "GracefulTakeover"
        }
      ],
      "Default": "Rollback"
    },
    "GracefulTakeover": {
      "Type": "Task",
      "End": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Why This Is Asked
Assesses ability to architect serverless SAP batch orchestration, cross-account security, idempotency, and auditability.

## Key Concepts
- Step Functions, Lambda
- SAP RFC batch submission, ABAP jobs
- Idempotency, retries, compensation
- STS cross-account credentials
- Centralized auditing

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPBatchLauncherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPBatchExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: arn:aws:iam::*:role/SAPOperatorRole
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  SAPBatchStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      DefinitionString:
        !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "SAP Batch Job Orchestration",
          "StartAt": "ValidateInput",
          "States": {
            "ValidateInput": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:validate-batch-input",
              "Next": "CheckIdempotency",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["Lambda.Unknown", "Lambda.ServiceException"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                "MaxAttempts": 3,
                "BackoffRate": 2.0
              }]
            },
            "CheckIdempotency": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:check-dedupe",
              "Next": "SubmitABAPJob",
              "Catch": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["DuplicateJob"],
                "Next": "SkipExecution"
              }]
            },
            "SubmitABAPJob": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:submit-abap-batch",
              "Next": "MonitorJob",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["SAPConnectionError", "RFCError"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                "MaxAttempts": 5,
                "BackoffRate": 2.0
              }, {
                "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 10,
                "MaxAttempts": 2,
                "BackoffRate": 1.5
              }],
              "Catch": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                "Next": "CancelJob",
                "ResultPath": "$.error"
              }]
            },
            "MonitorJob": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:monitor-abap-status",
              "Next": "LogCompletion",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["JobInProgress"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 30,
                "MaxAttempts": 20,
                "BackoffRate": 1.2
              }]
            },
            "CancelJob": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:cancel-abap-batch",
              "Next": "LogFailure",
              "Retry": [{
                "ErrorEquals": ["CancelError"],
                "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                "MaxAttempts": 3,
                "BackoffRate": 1.5
              }]
            },
            "LogCompletion": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:audit-log",
              "End": true
            },
            "LogFailure": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:audit-log",
              "End": true
            },
            "SkipExecution": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:#{AWS::Region}:#{AWS::AccountId}:function:audit-duplicate",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SAPBatchLauncherRole.Arn
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This tests practical ability to implement auditable patch management for SAP on AWS, a common, beginner-friendly operational task.

## Key Concepts
- AWS Systems Manager maintenance windows, Run Command, and State Manager
- DynamoDB as an audit ledger for approvals
- Health checks and rollback automation

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  PatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: [ssm.amazonaws.com, ec2.amazonaws.com]
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ['ssm:*', 'ec2:Describe*', 'dynamodb:*']
                Resource: '*'
  MaintWindow:
    Type: AWS::SSM::MaintenanceWindow
    Properties:
      Name: SAPPatchWindow
      Schedule: 'cron(0 2 ? * SUN *)'
      AllowUnassociatedTargets: true
```
